AntigravityFinishInput.description: Dashboard request containing the Google redirect URL.

callback_url.description: Full callback URL containing the OAuth state and authorization code.

AntigravityPollInput.description: Dashboard request to poll a Google OAuth flow.

local_callback.description: Whether the local callback listener is active.

CatalogProvider.description: Discovered models and the latest discovery error for a provider.

base_url.description: Endpoint used to decide whether cached results remain valid.

error.description: Most recent discovery failure, if any.

CodexPollInput.description: Dashboard request identifying a pending device flow.

user_code.description: Code to enter on the authorization page.

ConsoleConnection.description: `OpenCode` Console credentials used to retrieve a workspace balance.

workspace_id.description: Console workspace identifier sent as the organization header.

CreateKey.description: Request to create a named virtual key with optional restrictions.

models.description: Allowed model IDs; empty permits every model.

name.description: User-assigned name for the new key.

providers.description: Allowed provider IDs; empty permits every provider.

CreateProvider.description: Request to create a provider instance.

base_url.description: Upstream base URL, empty when the backend supplies a default.

id.description: Requested instance identifier for non-fixed kinds.

name.description: Requested instance name for non-fixed kinds.

CreatedKey.description: Newly created key including its one-time token.

key.description: Secret token, returned only on creation.

Credential.description: Credential metadata exposed without the underlying secret.

api_key.description: API key to store, when supplied.

enabled.description: Whether the credential can be selected.

InferenceDiscoveryError.description: Discovery failure for an individual provider.

InferenceModelList.description: OpenAI-compatible model list with per-provider discovery errors.

data.description: Provider model records, with qualified IDs.

InferenceRequest.description: Inference request with provider-qualified model and provider-specific fields.

additionalProperties.description: Remaining OpenAI-compatible request fields are passed through.

Interval.description: Calendar granularity used for dashboard request buckets.

KeyInfo.description: Public metadata for a virtual key, excluding its secret token.

id.description: Stable identifier used to revoke the key.

models.description: Model IDs allowed by the key.

providers.description: Provider IDs allowed by the key.

KeyList.description: Virtual keys returned without their tokens.

LogEntry.description: Serialized request log returned by the dashboard.

input_tokens.description: Reported input token count, when available.

model.description: Model named in the request body.

output_tokens.description: Reported output token count, when available.

provider.description: Provider extracted from the request path.

status.description: HTTP status, or 499 for an incomplete response stream.

ModelCatalog.description: Persisted snapshot of provider discovery results.

providers.description: Providers reconciled with the registry on load.

ModelData.description: Cached datasheet entries indexed by their source keys.

ModelSettings.description: URLs and intervals governing model metadata refreshes.

discovery_interval_minutes.description: Provider discovery interval in minutes; zero disables discovery.

pricing_interval_hours.description: Datasheet refresh interval in hours; zero disables refresh.

ObservabilityBucket.description: Request count for a UTC time bucket.

requests.description: Number of requests in the bucket.

ObservabilityResponse.description: Dashboard metrics and recent request logs.

ObservabilitySummary.description: Aggregate statistics for the selected range.

errors.description: Number of responses with status at least 400.

input_tokens.description: Sum of available input token counts.

output_tokens.description: Sum of available output token counts.

successes.description: Number of responses with status 200 through 399.

Provider.description: Active configured provider instance exposed by the registry.

ProviderDescriptor.description: Provider identity, authentication options, and migration policy.

api_key.description: Whether API key credentials are supported.

fixed_id.description: Fixed provider instance identifier, when applicable.

fixed_name.description: Fixed provider instance name, when applicable.

label.description: Display name for the provider kind.

windows.description: Individual windows reported by the provider.

QuotaSnapshot.description: Provider usage represented as quota windows or a monetary balance.

QuotaWindow.description: Usage remaining within a provider-defined time window.

remaining_percent.description: Remaining quota as a percentage, when available.

reset_at.description: Reset timestamp, when provided by the upstream.

SettingsResponse.description: Dashboard-visible settings without the OAuth client secret.

log_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain logs.

oauth_client_secret_set.description: Whether an OAuth client secret is stored.

base_url.description: Replacement upstream base URL, if supplied.

UpdateSettings.description: Partial settings update supplied by the dashboard.

oauth_client_secret.description: Optional replacement secret; an empty string clears it.
